scientific_hypothesis: Moshika has an untied text output projection and represents much Persian text through byte pieces. Previous LoRA plus input-embedding runs did not reliably overcome the English output prior. Rank-64 LoRA together with full adaptation of the text embeddings and untied text output projection, under a bounded text-focused objective, should have ample capacity to memorize 32 short train-only Persian exchanges while preserving audible base-model speech. Failure would falsify the current lightweight Moshika adaptation path before another full-corpus run.
